title: Gold: MACD 12h (Strategy Lab autopilot, best by stability + return)
source: Owner's request 23.11.2026: trade XAUUSDT on demo with the best strategy found by stability + return. Found by the owner's Strategy Lab engine (screener/screen.js, swing mode) on PAXG (tokenized gold) 2023-07..2026-11, branch workflow tradfi-gold-screen run 45177446124.

selection.rule: Highest autopilot score (Sharpe × equity R² × robustness) among the configurations that passed all seven checks, the target–decoy control and Benjamini–Hochberg significance on unseen data (walk-forward year + last 3 months). The top score overall (MACD 12h 12/58/10, score 1.98) was not significant on unseen data.
selection.units: engine results at 100 % of capital, 1x (Strategy Lab settings); the bot sizes by risk (0.1 % of equity per trade), so money results are far smaller; PF and win rate are comparable

caveats: Found on PAXG (tokenized gold, 24/7), not on Bybit's XAUUSDT (≈ 8 months of history). The perpetual tracks spot gold; PAXG trades a small premium and moves a little on weekends.
2023–2026 was a strong gold bull market. The decoys keep the drift (shuffled daily blocks), so passing them means the timing beat luck on this history – not that it will continue.

The best of 660 000 backtests on one instrument is selected with hindsight: in this run decoys passed all seven checks 8.4 times per copy against 62 real configurations. Only the forward record from the freeze is clean evidence.
Live entries only while gold trades (Globex hours); the engine also entered on weekends (carried to the Sunday open here).
decision_rule: Demo at exploration risk (0.1 % per trade). Judged on its own forward record against buy & hold of gold; with ~1.4 trades a month a statistical answer takes 1–2 years.
